name: Self-operating thermal switch
summary: A self-operating thermal switch responds directly to its thermal condition rather than through a separate powered relay input.
description: A self-operating thermal switch responds directly to its thermal condition rather than through a separate powered relay input. Its contact and reset behaviour are device-specific.
readingNotes: Trace the thermal device separately from any PLC or auxiliary supply.

distinction: A self-operating thermal switch is not the same as a powered temperature monitoring relay.
